not_found: No llms.txt on solana.ai itself (https://solana.ai/llms.txt returns 404) — the llms.txt family lives on solana.com.
No llms.txt or docs bundle on mcp.solana.com — the host answers JSON-RPC only.
No second first-party skills repo: the solana.ai 'Agent Skills' card resolves to solana-foundation/solana-dev-skill; all other skills are community skills catalogued in awesome-solana-ai.
solana.com/ai and solana.com/agents could not be verified from this environment (bot checkpoint on plain fetches); the registry page solana.ai links is https://solana.com/agent-registry.

resources.covers: Remote MCP server: canonical Solana docs retrieval (list_sections, get_documentation), semantic docs search (Solana_Documentation_Search), expert Q&A (Solana_Expert__Ask_For_Help), and program_autofixer, a static security linter for Anchor/Pinocchio program Rust. Server identity solana-mcp v2.0.0, protocol 2025-03-26. Free, no API key.
resources.in_this_kit: Built-in kit-mcp server (namespace `solana`). 3 of 5 tools annotate readOnlyHint; the 2 unannotated Q&A tools are classified consequential under the fail-closed policy.
resources.name: Solana Developer MCP

resources.covers: The Solana Foundation's Agent Skill for modern Solana development: @solana/kit SDK, wallet UI, web3.js v3 interop, Anchor/Pinocchio programs, Surfpool/LiteSVM/Mollusk testing, Codama codegen, security patterns, toolchain compatibility. SKILL.md + 36 reference files.
resources.in_this_kit: Vendored byte-faithful at skills/solana-dev/ (SKILL.md + 36 reference files + LICENSE from upstream commit c9da2624; sha256-verified; provenance in skills/SOURCES.md).
resources.name: Solana Development Skill (solana-dev)

resources.covers: The 'Browse all Solana AI tools' index linked from solana.ai: curated AI coding skills (General / DeFi / Infrastructure / Mobile & Seeker — Helius, Metaplex, Jupiter, Drift, Kamino, Orca, Raydium, Squads, Light Protocol, Pyth, Switchboard, Alchemy, QuickNode and more), AI agents, developer tools, learning resources. Community-contributed; the repo itself carries a not-endorsed / DYOR disclaimer.

resources.covers: TypeScript toolkit connecting agents to 60+ Solana actions (tokens, NFTs, swaps, lending, staking, perps, bridging) with LangChain / Vercel AI SDK / OpenAI tool adapters. The 'Solana Agent Kit' card on solana.ai. Distinct from this repo (OpenClawd agent kit, Rust).
resources.in_this_kit: Indexed here for disambiguation; not vendored.
resources.name: Solana Agent Kit (SendAI)

resources.covers: Onchain agent identity, reputation, and validation registries on Solana, interoperable with ERC-8004 on Ethereum. Ecosystem: 8004.org (standard hub), 8004scan.io (explorer), 8004market.io (marketplace), SATI dashboard (sati.cascade.fyi).
resources.in_this_kit: Indexed here; the kit's own identity work (Metaplex Agent Registry) is documented separately and is a different registry.
resources.name: Solana Agent Registry

resources.covers: The canonical Solana docs as agent-readable markdown: llms.txt is the index (every page also available as raw .md), llms-full.txt is the full corpus in one file, and scoped per-section llms.txt files exist for single-task context saving.
resources.in_this_kit: Indexed here and reachable live through the kit's `solana` MCP server. Not vendored: solana.com bot-walls plain HTTP fetches from this build environment, and the corpus is a living document — link and fetch live instead.
resources.name: Solana documentation for agents (llms.txt family)

resources.covers: The solana.ai homepage's own products, for context rather than as dev resources: pay.sh (per-call agent payments in USDC, no accounts), Payment Channels (authorize once, settle once), the Solana Developer Platform APIs under them (wallets, payments, token issuance, policies, compliance screening, payouts), Milo (autonomous trading agent), and a confidential-hardware AI chat.
resources.name: solana.ai product stack (context)
